payload.claim: The acceptance criterion requires `lines added`/`lines removed` to appear *after* the five existing summary terms, but `_PageParser.dls` stores each `<dl>`'s terms in a plain dict keyed by term name, so `test_a_task_summary_shows_the_lines_added_and_removed_the_ledger_holds` only checks `page.summary["lines added"]`/`["lines removed"]` by key, never their position relative to `state`/`risk`/`batch`/`pull request`/`cost`. Replacing `summary_terms.append(...)` with `summary_terms.insert(0, ...)` for both new terms would move them to the front of the `<dl>` instead of the end, yet every existing test, including this one, would still pass because none asserts term order.
